extension-build.description: Builds a Blender extension's archives with blender --command extension build

package.description: Packs a built Adobe UXP plugin into a .ccx and signs a built CEP extension into a .zxp

extension-constraints.description: Rewrites a uv root's constraint rows from the distributions the installed Blender bundles

install.description: Installs the host packages a project's build wrote into their hosts through each host's own installer

release-publish.description: Publishes the host packages a project's build wrote to each host's package server, skipping versions the server already holds

unreal-build.description: Builds Unreal Engine projects' editor targets through UnrealBuildTool and packages plug-ins through AutomationTool's BuildPlugin, one task at a time

place.description: Places an unpacked Adobe UXP plug-in or CEP extension into its host folder by rename
